metadata.name: GetCardDetails
metadata.description: This API is used to retrieve card embossing details by providing the account\admin number and card sequence number in input. Details like card limit, expiry date, manual status, card type, etc. are returned..

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: Either of AdminNumber or AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: Either of AdminNumber or AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: CardSequenceNumber
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: EmbossingGroup
children.description: This is a group of Embossing related fields.

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Admin number. Example: 12345

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Date when card is be expired. Format: MM/YYYY Example: 02/2020 Allowable Values: 7

children.name: PendingCardExpirationDate
children.description: Date when pending card is expired. Format: MM/YYYY Example: 02/2020 Allowable Values: 7

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Example: 2

children.name: VirtualCardLimit
children.description: Card limit of Secondary Cards, both Physical and Virtual. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:1000.00

children.name: NewCardTransactionsSpendLimit
children.description: Indicates New Card spend limit for CNP or Contactless transactions as per set up. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: VirtualCardAvailableLimit
children.description: Usage Limit available on Secondary Cards, both Physical and Virtual. Valid Values: 0-9 (Dollar Amount) Example: 200.00

children.name: PINAttempts
children.description: Number of PIN Attempts. Example: 2

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Example: John J Allowable Values: 50

children.name: IssueStatus
children.description: Status of the Card Issue. Example: Activated Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardType
children.description: Type of the card as Primary or Secondary. Example: Primary Card Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardActivationDate
children.description: Date when card is activated. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Card Holder's Account number. Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CancellationStatus
children.description: Status of the Card Cancellation. Example: Cancelled Lost Card Allowable Values: 100

children.name: DateIssued
children.description: Date when card is issued. Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example: 01/25/2020

children.name: CustomerType
children.description: This tag reflects the customer type, like Individual, organisation etc. Example: Individual Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardClosedDate
children.description: Date when card is closed. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: ReissueReportDate
children.description: Date when card is reissued. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: PreissueReportDate
children.description: Date when card is preissued. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: SSNLast4Digits
children.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN. Example: 1120 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: AssociatedAddress
children.description: Associated address of the card holder. Example: 12th Street Road Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DateOfBirth
children.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: HoldPlastic
children.description: Field which determines if a plastic card is to be created or not. Valid Values: No/Yes Format: XXX Example: No/Yes Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DeliveryMechanism
children.description: Delivery Mechanism (Overnight, Priority or Standard) Example: Standard, Priority, Overnight Standard Exp, Priority Exp, Overnight Exp(Condition:Standard Exp, Priority Exp, Overnight Exp are only applicable for Perfect Plastic Card Vendor) Allowable Values: 40

children.name: DeliveryDate
children.description: Date when card is delivered to the card holder. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: TotalOutStandingAmount
children.description: Total outstanding amount as on statement date. Example: 200.00

children.name: TotalOutStandingCount
children.description: Count of Total Outstandings. Example: 2

children.name: CashOutStandingAmount
children.description: Total outstanding cash amount as on statement date. Example: 200.00

children.name: CashOutStandingCount
children.description: Count of Cash Outstandings. Example: 2

children.name: PurchaseOutStandingAmount
children.description: Total outstanding purchase amount as on statement date. Example: 200.00

children.name: PurchaseOutStandingCount
children.description: Count of Purchase Outstandings. Example: 2

children.name: ReturnOutStandingAmount
children.description: Total outstanding return amount as on statement date. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: ReturnOutStandingCount
children.description: Count of return Outstandings. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example: 12

children.name: EmbossingManualStatus
children.description: Manual status of card. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section "5.21 Card/Account Statuses" for a valid set of values. Example: 2 - Active, 3 - Delinquent, 4 - Overlimit, 7 - Fraud, 10 - Blocked, 11 - Closed

children.name: EmbossingManualStatusText
children.description: Text for the Manual Embossing Status. Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmbossingGeneratedStatus
children.description: Generated Status of the Embossing. Example: 2

children.name: EmbossingGeneratedStatusText
children.description: Generated Status for Card Embossing in text description. Valid Values:0-9 A-Z Format:XXXX Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: VirtualCardExpiryDate
children.description: Date when Virtual Card will be Expired. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: VirtualCardExpiryOptions
children.description: Expiry options provided for selection for Virtual Card. E.g. Same as Primary card or any customized date. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: VirtualCardLimitMethod
children.description: Method on which Virtual Card limit is applied e.g. Account / Card Example: 0 - Account, 1 - Card

children.name: UsageRestriction
children.description: Usage restrictions applied on the card. E.g. International Usage restriction. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardActivationInvalidAttempts
children.description: Number of Invalid Attempts for Card Activation. Example: 2

children.name: AvailableDeliveryMechanisms
children.description: Available Delivery Mechanisms

children.name: LutCode
children.description: Lookup Code.

children.name: LutDescription
children.description: Lookup Description.

children.name: StatusApplicable
children.description: Lookup StatusApplicable.

children.name: SameAsParentAddress
children.description: A flag which will refer the same address as parent address. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AllowReissueCancelledCard
children.description: A flag which if marked will allow reissuance of cancelled card. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID provided by CoreCARD Example: Newuser123 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AllowSecurityAnswerReset
children.description: If the flag "AllowSecurityAnswerReset" is true then we display the button "Reset Security Answer" on the panel. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: AllowPasswordReset
children.description: If the flag "AllowPasswordReset" is true then we display the button "Reset Password" on the panel. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: TokenStatus
children.description: Token status of a card number e.g. Active / Inactive. Example: 0

children.name: CardImageID
children.description: This is the card image type number which is already decided for embossing them. Example: 12 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: UniversalUniqueID
children.description: Universal Unique Identification Number generated by system From StatementHeader Example: 233d6bc3-9242-11e8-82e3-509a4c38ceea Allowable Values: 64

children.name: ActivationCode
children.description: Code which is provided at the time of Account Creation/Registration should be pass as a user validation. Example: 123456 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalCardActivationCode
children.description: Code which is provided at the time of Account Creation/Registration should be pass as a user validation for additional card. Example: 123456 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RegistrationStatus
children.description: User ID Enrolled for SelfService registration status. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: UserStatus
children.description: Status of the user. Example: 1 - Deceased

children.name: AllowResetVirtualCardLimit
children.description: Checks that account is allowed to reset Virtual Card Limit or not. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: NumberOfPINTry
children.description: Number of Pin Try. Example: 3

children.name: AllowedTxnsOnVirtualCard
children.description: Number of allowed transactions on Virtual Card. Example: 2

children.name: RemainingAllowedTxnOnVirtualCard
children.description: Number of transactions remaining on the virtual card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

children.name: AllowResetTxnOnVirtualCard
children.description: If this account allow to reset transaction on Virtual Card. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: MaskedCardNumber
children.description: Masked Card Number. Format: XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Example: 4567 89XX XXXX 0123 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AllowResetPINAttempts
children.description: This tag reflects if it is allowed to Reset PIN Attempts. Example: 0 - false, 1 - true

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: This tag reflects the customer ID. Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: ManualCardStatus
children.description: Manual Status of the Card. Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastStandInFileAction
children.description: This field will hold the value displayed on Embossing Details panel as described in section 3.2.1. Embossing Details panel. Valid Values: String minLength: 0 maxLength: 1 Format: NNNN Example: 1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: StandInFilePurgeDate
children.description: This field will hold the value displayed on Embossing Details panel as described in section 3.2.1. Embossing Details panel. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: AllowCashTransactions
children.description: Indicates if cash transactions are allowed on this card or not Example: True, False

children.name: UsageLimitResetFrequency
children.description: Displays applicable usage limit reset frequency for secondary card. Valid Values: 0-1 0 = None 1 = Billing Cycle

children.name: CashUsageLimit
children.description: Cash Usage Limit on the secondary card. Valid Values:0-9 (Dollar Amount) Format:XXXX.XX Example:1000.00

children.name: AvailableCashUsageLimit
children.description: Cash Usage Limit available on Secondary Cards Valid Values: 0-9 (Dollar Amount) Format:XXXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: SSFailedLoginAttempts
children.description: The number of failed login attempts by a SelfService user. It will reset to 0 after a successful login. Example: 3

children.name: SSUserStatus
children.description: Self Service User’s status. Possible Values: 0,1,2,3,4,5. Code Description: 0=Active 1=Locked 2=Closed 3=Suspended 5=Auto Locked

children.name: EmbossingLine4
children.description: Embossing line4 Valid Values: A-Z Example: XYZ Allowable Values: 20

children.name: CardLocked
children.description: Indicates whether to lock or unlock the card through the API: 'Yes' locks and 'No' unlocks. Valid Values: 0- No,1- Yes Example: 1

children.name: IsTemporaryCardLimitActive
children.description: BusinessName Example: 0,1

children.name: TemporaryCardLimitExpirationDate
children.description: BusinessName Example: 0,1

children.name: FallbackCardLimit
children.description: BusinessName Example: 0,1
